messages.subject: exporting CN ratios for Affy500K w/o extractRawCopyNumbers
parts:
Dear Henrik,

I am trying to export the CN ratios for a few thousands Affy500K.
So far, I am using the extractRawCopyNumbers function which works but
is pretty slow (I am on a shared-network disc...).
I was wondering if you had any documentation somewhere on how you
combine the NSP and STY chips?
So that I could try writing something using the extractTheta function
which would be much faster (as it will not need to read these many
files).

If no such doc exists then I could try moving these data locally
(although I will still be curious to have a brief description of what
this function does :-) ).
This brings me with another (simple) question, does the
extractRawCopyNumbers function works only with data under cbsData or
does it also needs everything from probeData and plmData?

Thanks a lot,
Armand
